aren_vale.description: A twenty-year-old from Greymere: meek, trusting, conflict-averse, and unusually willing to see good in people. Every attempt to stay out of trouble pulls them deeper into it. Not a chosen one — the Crest under the Hollow Court simply answered.
aren_vale.name: Aren Vale

cassian_orre.description: A former strategist and Crest critic, publicly presumed dead. Known early only as a historical figure of anti-Crest thought. His aim — destroy every Crest and end the arms race — is revealed much later.
cassian_orre.name: Cassian Orre

elara_thorne.description: An experienced sanctioned Duelist stationed near Greymere. She understands why Crest restrictions exist, disagrees with some of the policies she enforces, and believes reform beats rebellion.
elara_thorne.name: Warden Elara Thorne

mara_vale.description: One of Aren's parents. Once worked alongside Cassian Orre on forbidden Crest research before they split over the future of Crests. Raised Aren away from the consequences of that history.
mara_vale.name: Mara Vale

mira_solen.description: A young archive assistant: practical, curious, more socially confident than Aren, and sceptical of official history. A bridge into Crest lore and the records nobody is allowed to read.
mira_solen.name: Mira Solen

serin_dain.description: A sanctioned Duelist the protagonist's age: trained, observant, suspicious, decisive, and fundamentally moral. Believes trust must be earned before it is given. Often right about that.
serin_dain.name: Serin Dain
